summary: Well‑executed, preregistered paired confirmatory study that transparently used shared_initial_candidate semantics and archived artifacts; result is a clear ceiling/null outcome (600/600 passes; no repairs invoked). Methods, preregistration fidelity, analysis, and disclosure meet the paper’s stated requirements and are consistent with the archived execution manifest. No unsupported claims or unexplained deviations were found. Recommend minor optional edits for presentation and emphasis, but no substantive revisions required.
optional_revisions: Condense the Disclosure Statement to reduce replication of execution-log detail while preserving the mandatory master‑prompt locator and SHA‑256 pair.

In Related Work or References, ensure all bibliography entries appear in conventional IEEE reference formatting (author list, title, venue, year, identifier) if the compiled PDF does not already render them that way.

Explicitly state in the Methods (single short sentence) the archived sampling record fields exactly as they appear (e.g., temperature = null/unset) and point readers to the model_configuration.json artifact path and hash for reproducibility; the manuscript already notes this, but a single-line cross‑reference to the artifact hash would improve traceability.

Consider adding one sentence in the Discussion reminding readers that the observed ceiling result does not imply general absence of benefit from validators/repairs under alternative generation semantics or harder task banks.
